raw_html: [[Large Scorpion Poison]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Large Scorpion Poison]]:''' On a critical hit, this weapon injects the target with Large Scorpion poison, causing 1 to 4 Constitution loss with an additional 1 to 4 Constitution loss after 1 minute if a DC 14 [[Fortitude save]] is failed.
